scenes.narration: An audit flagged ₹413 crore in damages not levied. ₹103 crore was recovered.
scenes.image_prompt: Indian man, about 34, news anchor, medium-brown skin, short curly black hair, light stubble, rimless glasses, charcoal blazer over a black crew-neck, in a dark studio, facing camera, serious expression, medium shot

scenes.narration: This is from the CAG's report "Adding Value to Public Governance 2025-26". According to Business Standard, it was presented to the President in October.
scenes.image_prompt: Close-up of a bound government audit report on a desk, shallow depth of field, office light
scenes.speaker: Nisha
scenes.photo: Comptroller and Auditor General of India office

scenes.narration: According to Business Standard's reading of the report, recoveries worth ₹4,251.34 crore followed its audits.
scenes.image_prompt: Indian rupee notes being counted on a table, close-up, warm light
scenes.speaker: Aditya

scenes.narration: The largest single item, ₹3,389 crore, came from income-tax reassessments of banks and NBFCs.
scenes.image_prompt: Generic Indian bank branch exterior, daytime, street-level camera angle
scenes.speaker: Aditya

scenes.narration: At the Shree Singaji thermal power project in Madhya Pradesh, ₹103.64 crore was recovered from the contractor, about a quarter of the ₹413.25 crore flagged.
scenes.image_prompt: Indian coal thermal power plant with cooling towers and smoke at dusk, wide shot
scenes.speaker: Nisha

scenes.narration: In Maharashtra, ₹3.84 crore in duplicate Covid ex-gratia payments was flagged. By December 2024, ₹92.50 lakh had been recovered.
scenes.image_prompt: Mumbai street scene with people in masks, documentary style, medium shot
scenes.speaker: Aditya

scenes.narration: Other cases recovered more. At BSNL, ₹42.71 crore of ₹47.69 crore, nearly 90 percent.
scenes.image_prompt: Indian telecom tower against evening sky, low angle
scenes.speaker: Nisha

scenes.narration: The report says it chose cases showing clear corrective action, and that "time lags between audit findings and observable outcomes are common." It gives no overall figure for unrecovered amounts.
